## Cross-Cutting Issues

### Issue #1: Missing `dateModified` (11 of 12 posts)
All modified posts except `affiliate-seo-bangladesh` (now fixed) lack a `dateModified` field. This field is needed for ArticleSchema freshness signals. Only ~10 posts in the entire `data.js` file have this field — it's a systematic gap.

**Recommended fix:** Add `dateModified: "<YYYY-MM-DD>"` to each post object. Use the post's `date` value as the initial `dateModified`.

### Issue #2: AEO/GEO thin in one post
`recovering-google-penalties-bangladesh-guide` has only 1 question-based heading ("What is a Google Penalty?"). Needs ≥ 2.

**Details:** The post appears to have standard content headings but doesn't frame them as questions. Adding an H2 like "How Do Bangladeshi Sites Get Penalized?" or "What Happens After a Manual Action?" would fix this.

### Issue #3: Pillar link advisory (2 posts)
- `recovering-google-penalties-bangladesh-guide`: Links to `/services/*` pages but not the main SEO pillar blog (`/blog/complete-seo-guide-bangladesh-businesses-2026`)
- `seo-knowledge-panel-bangladesh`: Same pattern — links to `/services/*` but not the pillar blog

While not strictly required (service pillar pages are acceptable), adding a link to the main SEO guide pillar blog would strengthen cluster alignment.
